title: Sapped
wikitext:
{{status | name = Sap | type = Ailment | description = You deal less damage. }} '''Sapped''' is an [[Ailment|Elemental Ailment]] associated with [[lightning]] that causes the affected targets to deal up to 20% less [[damage]], based on the amount of Lightning Damage in the hit, for 4 seconds. ==Mechanics== The player and enemies can deal up to 20% less damage due to the sap ailment. Sap's minimum effect is 2%; any sap of lesser effect than that is discarded. For sap that is not inflicted by damage, such as from [[Transfer-attuned Spirit Shield]], the default value is 6%. The effect of sap is calculated using the following formula:https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3123794 {{math|formula= E = 1/3 * ({D \over T})^{0.4} * ( 1 + M ) }} where D is the lightning damage dealt, T is the enemy's ailment threshold, and M is the sum of the attacker's increases to the effect of sap or lightning ailments (normally 0%). In the great majority of cases, a monster's ailment threshold is equal to its maximum life. It primarily differs for especially high-life monsters (such as [[The Shaper]]), where the threshold is reduced to allow [[ailment]]s to be applied with hits that wouldn't ordinarily reach the required life thresholds.[[Version 3.9.0]] Patch notes Playtesting estimates the ailment threshold on [[Sirus, Awakener of Worlds|Sirus, the Awakener of Worlds]] to be 25 million damage, or approximately 35% of boss life.https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/f00clz/ailment_threshold_numbers_revealed_25mil_shock/ ===Example sap values=== {| class="wikitable" |- !Resulting

The following passives are related to lightning ailment in general: {{Query base passive skills |where= passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Lightning Ailment%" }} ===Cluster jewel passives=== The following [[cluster jewel]]-only passives are related to Sap or lightning ailment in general: {{Passive skill table |q_where= passive_skills.id LIKE "affliction%" AND ( passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Sap%" OR passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%Lightning Ailment%" ) |large=1 |stat_text=1 }} ==See also== * [[Scorch]] alternative ailment for fire damage * [[Brittle]] alternative ailment for cold damage ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.21.1| * Elemental Ailments other than Freeze are no longer discarded if their duration is lower than 300ms. }} {{Version history table row|3.10.0| * Scorch, Brittle and Sap now all have a base duration of 4 seconds (from 2). }} {{Version history table row|3.9.0| * We've added an Ailment Threshold to monsters. In the great majority of cases, the Ailment Threshold matches the monster's Maximum Life. It primarily differs for especially high-life monsters (such as The Shaper), where the threshold is reduced to allow ailments to be applied with hits that wouldn't ordinarily reach the required Life thresholds. * The alternate ailments '''Sap''', Scorch and Brittle have a slightly different calculation as they have lower caps on their magnitudes. }} {{Version history table row|3.5.0| * Introduced to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist|refs={{cite web|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2256189/page/1|title=Here are the new ailments and information about what they do!|date=December 6, 2018|accessdate=March 1, 2020|author=Bex_GGG|publisher=Path of Exile Forums}}}} [[Category:Ailments]]
